sections.h2: When Kingsport property tax is due
sections.html:
City tax goes delinquent on December 1, with the due date falling on November 30. The city's property tax page sets the penalties: 2% on December 1, another 2% on January 1, and then 1% for every month until the bill is paid.

Statements go out between mid September and mid October, after the state approves the assessments. Values are fixed as of January 1. You can mail a payment, drop it in the night deposit box, or pay at the Customer Service Center in City Hall, 415 Broad Street. Questions go to 423-343-9860.

The county bill runs on a different calendar. Sullivan County tax is due the first Monday in October and can be paid without penalty through the last day of February. That means a Kingsport owner may face a November 30 city deadline and a February county deadline in the same season, so mark both. If you hold an escrow account with a lender, the lender usually pays the bills for you, so ask the servicer which of the two it covers.

sections.h2: Other offices that touch your bill
sections.html:
Values come from the Sullivan County Property Assessor, and the Sullivan County Trustee collects the county portion. The Trustee's FAQ page gives the main office as 1651 Blountville Boulevard in Blountville, 423-323-6464, open weekdays from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. A Kingsport satellite office at 225 West Center Street, Suite 101, takes payments Monday through Wednesday from October 1 to March 15 at 423-354-7036 and is closed from mid March through September.

Part of Kingsport lies in Hawkins County. A house there answers to the Hawkins County assessor and trustee, so call the Hawkins County Trustee for that county's dates and rate.

Other Sullivan County payment rules:

  • A courtesy notice is mailed, though Tennessee does not require one
  • Installments are allowed between October 1 and February 28, and you track the balance yourself
  • Cards carry a 2.5% fee and e-checks a $1.25 fee
  • Interest runs at 1.5% per month from March 1, and payment is taken through March 15 before the account moves to the Clerk and Master

Kingsport's 2025 city rate is $1.67 per $100 of assessed value, down from $1.99 for 2024. Sullivan County's 2025 rate is $1.6129. The city links the drop to the state's two-year ratio appraisal, which cost Kingsport about $3.8 million a year in revenue, and to Sullivan County's 2025 reassessment, its first since 2021. Residential property is assessed at 25% of appraised value, and your bill uses your own rates and assessment, so check the notice you receive.

Kingsport lies along the Holston River in western Sullivan County and reaches into Hawkins County. Kingsport City Schools serve almost every resident, with Dobyns-Bennett High School as the main high school. The city had 57,530 residents on July 1, 2025, up 3.6% from April 2020, and 25,021 households. About 60.1% of homes are owner-occupied, the median owner-occupied home value is $234,100, median gross rent is $907, and median household income is $52,490.

Because a fair share of households rent, a seller may be handling a rental with tenants. Check both city and county balances early so nothing surprises the closing agent.

A short checklist before listing: confirm the city balance at 423-343-9860, confirm the county balance with the Trustee, note whether any part of the lot lies in Hawkins County, and keep your last notice handy. Title companies ask for those first, and having them ready shortens the closing. If a payoff request goes out well before the closing day, ask for an updated figure the week of closing so the penalty and interest line up with the actual date.

Values follow a set yearly cycle. Ownership and condition are fixed as of January 1, change notices are due by May 20, and the county board of equalization meets starting June 1 and through that month. Sullivan County reassessed in 2025, so many Kingsport owners saw a new number that year. Check the notice in May each year for the same reason.

Steps if you disagree with a value:

  • Call the Sullivan County Assessor before the June board meets and ask whether an informal review is offered
  • File with the county board of equalization, since skipping it generally ends later appeal rights
  • Gather sales of similar Kingsport houses and explain differences in age, condition and size
  • Pay the undisputed part of the bill on time while the dispute is open

The state's appeal rules start at the county board, and the Sullivan Assessor can tell you when it sits.

sections.h2: Relief for seniors and disabled owners
sections.html:
The city has a relief program for elderly or disabled homeowners within income limits, and it links a brochure and the state Comptroller's relief page. Sullivan County has no Tax Freeze program, so relief is the route here. If you have a mortgage, the relief voucher must be signed and returned by April 5 each year or the state voids the credit.

Relief pays back part of what you owe after the fact, so keep paying the bill on time while an application is pending. Ask City Hall or the Trustee for the paperwork well before April. A seller who plans to list in the spring should check whether a voucher is pending, because an unsigned voucher can cost a credit that would otherwise reduce the bill.

The owner of record on January 1 receives the notice, and a buyer who closes later is still responsible for seeing that the tax is paid on time. The settlement statement spells out the split. Once the November 30 city deadline passes, city penalties and county interest keep growing each month, so ask for payoff figures dated close to the closing day.

Unpaid tax is cleared from the seller's proceeds at the table. Call the city at 423-343-9860 and the Trustee in Blountville for written payoffs. A cash buyer can close on a short timeline and take on the paperwork, which helps if a house has fallen behind or sits in an estate.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss the November 30 Kingsport deadline?
faqs.a: A 2% penalty applies on December 1, another 2% on January 1, and 1% each month after until you pay. Mail, the night deposit box and the City Hall counter at 415 Broad Street are all accepted.

faqs.q: Is the Kingsport city rate going up or down?
faqs.a: The 2025 city rate is $1.67 per $100, lower than the $1.99 charged for 2024. The city ties the shift to the state's ratio appraisal and the 2025 Sullivan County reassessment.

faqs.q: Where do I pay the Sullivan County part of my Kingsport tax?
faqs.a: Pay the Sullivan County Trustee in Blountville or at the Kingsport satellite office on West Center Street, open Monday through Wednesday from October 1 to March 15. Online and phone payments add card or e-check fees.

faqs.q: Does Kingsport have a tax freeze for seniors?
faqs.a: Sullivan County has no Tax Freeze program. The state tax relief program covers eligible elderly and disabled owners, and the voucher goes back by April 5.

faqs.q: Can a Kingsport house with unpaid taxes still be sold?
faqs.a: Yes. Unpaid city and county balances are paid from the seller's proceeds at closing. Get written payoff figures from the city and the county Trustee before the closing date.
